description: Machine-readable registry for retained VeriSec Forge / VeriPatch-RR artifacts. This registry maps existing reports to bounded claims; it does not introduce new results.

experiments.title: PrimeVul Shortcut Controls
experiments.claim: same-source vulnerability detection success is artifact-sensitive and needs paired controls
experiments.boundary: benchmark diagnosis, not a deployed vulnerability detector or universal benchmark indictment

experiments.title: VeriPatch-RR v0.1
experiments.claim: paired vulnerable/fixed transformations can evaluate relational consistency separately from pointwise accuracy
experiments.boundary: measurement instrument; runtime visibility remains model-tokenizer specific

experiments.title: Pair-Coupled Decoding Mainline
experiments.claim: task-structured pair-coupled decoding is the strongest retained PrimeVul paired-diff layer
experiments.boundary: closed retained split evidence, not open-set expert discovery

experiments.title: Learned Joint Pairwise Baseline
experiments.claim: learned joint side choice is useful but not stronger than the retained pair-coupled reference
experiments.boundary: promising baseline and stress evidence, not the final relational solution

experiments.title: Qwen VeriPatch-RR Smoke
experiments.claim: a frozen Qwen instrumented smoke run exposes relational failure under VeriPatch-RR
experiments.boundary: model-specific smoke evidence, not a broad model-quality benchmark

experiments.title: Cross-Model Relational Audit
experiments.claim: cross-architecture controls separate side-order inconsistency from endpoint sensitivity
experiments.boundary: competency-controlled architecture comparison, not architecture-only causal proof

experiments.title: Cross-Model Replication
experiments.claim: distilgpt2 and generative-judge slots broaden stress coverage of relational failure modes
experiments.boundary: low-canonical stress evidence, not universal strong-model failure proof

experiments.title: Decoder Stress Validation
experiments.claim: relation-consistent decoding can enforce declared relation structure on retained predictions under randomized-pair and identity-distortion controls
experiments.boundary: post-hoc structural control; not a model reasoning improvement claim or benchmark leaderboard result

experiments.title: Decoder Failure Case Audit
experiments.claim: identity-distortion audit explains when relation-consistent decoding reshapes canonical predictions
experiments.boundary: post-hoc failure audit using gold labels only for consequence analysis; not a decoder improvement or model reasoning claim

experiments.title: External Generalization And Routing
experiments.claim: source-aware paired-diff experts and closed-world routing improve retained robustness checks
experiments.boundary: bounded closed-world routing evidence, not open-set expert discovery

experiments.title: Evidence-Coupled Audit
experiments.claim: WITHDRAWN: the side-correct vs side-wrong evidence contrast is circular -- the target is antisymmetric in the predicted side, so flipping the side flips the target deterministically
experiments.boundary: Withdrawn as a localization result. Not localization accuracy, not localization recall, not independently human-validated evidence quality. See reports/PRIMEVUL_EVIDENCE_HEURISTIC_CONSISTENCY.md

experiments.title: Qwen Relational Mechanism Audit
experiments.claim: context cap, terminal-context sensitivity, and representation effects are separable failure modes
experiments.boundary: mechanism audit for a retained setup, not a general repair of side-order reasoning

experiments.title: Same-Backbone Readout Ablation
experiments.claim: readout-conditioned training can control endpoint robustness
experiments.boundary: mechanism evidence; no readout variant is promoted as a better classifier

experiments.title: Independent Readout Confirmation
experiments.claim: independent confirmation replicates the readout mechanism pattern
experiments.boundary: mechanism confirmation, not canonical non-inferiority

experiments.title: Frozen-Backbone Readout Control
experiments.claim: frozen-backbone controls separate direct pooling effects from training-mediated effects
experiments.boundary: one fixed Qwen+LoRA representation; does not solve side-order reasoning

experiments.title: Controlled Training Synthesis
experiments.claim: matched-compute two-seed controls show an observed 1.5B bf16 < 7B nf4 < 3B bf16 ordering on discordant pairs
experiments.boundary: one Qwen model family, two seeds per arm, and a 7B quantization confound; this is not a general secure-patch reasoning solution

experiments.title: Decontaminated and Mined Discordant-Supply Control
experiments.claim: decontamination and mined supply leave balanced delta nearly unchanged and produce only small mean discordant movements
experiments.boundary: the largest mean gap is below the largest within-arm seed range but slightly above the smallest; with two seeds, no data-supply improvement is established

experiments.title: Training-Seed Precision Sensitivity Analysis
experiments.claim: a third seed is a useful minimum diagnostic but remains inadequate for a sharp seed-level mean estimate
experiments.boundary: planning variance is estimated from only two seeds and is a sensitivity calculation, not a preregistered power guarantee

experiments.title: Antisymmetric Repair Evaluation
experiments.claim: the antisymmetric readout enforces structural consistency, while the learned fine-tuning increment is not validated as transferable repair
experiments.boundary: structural constraint, not a general learned repair; CrossVul and nuisance-transfer criteria remain the headline boundary

experiments.title: VeriPatch-RR External Adapter Smoke
experiments.claim: external users can submit fixed-contract predictions and reproduce relational metrics on a smoke artifact
experiments.boundary: 30-pair / 90-row adapter sanity check; not a model-quality benchmark

experiments.title: CI Fresh-Clone Smoke Gate
experiments.claim: focused fresh-clone checks validate packaging, adapter plumbing, paper anchors, report index, and retained manifests
experiments.boundary: CI smoke gate; does not train models, run GPU inference, or validate model quality
